name: condition_integrations
purpose: Condition-level evidence groupings for displaying matched DNA indicators as potential health patterns without converting marker counts into probabilities or diagnoses.

policy.counting: Count unique curated marker IDs with a verified call and a non-zero reported effect. Cross-pack copies of one rsID count once within a condition.
policy.denominator: The denominator is the number of indicator IDs curated for the condition, not a disease probability denominator.
policy.prs: Polygenic risk scores remain context-only unless a calibrated score and validation metadata are present; these groupings do not calculate PRS values.
policy.diagnostic_language: A clinical-variant route may be shown when a marker is explicitly authored as clinically actionable, but a consumer-array call remains unconfirmed until an appropriate clinical test verifies it.

coverage_gaps.label: POTS & dysautonomia
coverage_gaps.display: No validated consumer-array POTS or dysautonomia model is scored here. Recurrent symptoms on standing—such as lightheadedness, palpitations, tremulousness, blurred vision, weakness, fatigue, or exercise intolerance—are useful context to discuss with a clinician, not a DNA risk result.
coverage_gaps.clinical_next_step: Discuss symptom timing and duration, positional heart rate and blood pressure, medications, hydration, and other possible causes with a clinician. POTS requires clinical evaluation; do not start salt loading, supplements, or medication changes from a DNA report.

coverage_gaps.label: Hypermobile Ehlers-Danlos syndrome
coverage_gaps.display: No single validated consumer-array marker panel establishes hypermobile EDS. Use hypermobility, tissue, skin, injury, and family-history assessment.

conditions.label: PMDD-related steroid sensitivity
conditions.plain_meaning: This group reflects research on how the brain and body respond to normal ovarian-steroid changes; it does not indicate high estrogen or progesterone levels.
conditions.clinical_route: Compare daily symptoms across at least two cycles with a clinician's PMDD evaluation.

conditions.label: EDS-spectrum connective-tissue pattern
conditions.plain_meaning: Several common collagen, tendon, and connective-tissue markers align with a hypermobility or tissue-laxity discussion; common markers do not identify hEDS or an EDS subtype.
conditions.clinical_route: If symptoms fit, review Beighton score, instability, skin features, injury history, and family history with a clinician.

conditions.label: Type 2 diabetes susceptibility context
conditions.plain_meaning: Multiple common glucose and insulin markers align with research on type 2 diabetes susceptibility; fasting glucose and HbA1c show what is happening now.
conditions.clinical_route: Review HbA1c, fasting glucose, blood pressure, waist or weight trend, and family history.

conditions.label: Appetite and weight-regulation context
conditions.plain_meaning: This pattern points to research on appetite, satiety, and energy regulation; it can help tailor experiments around meals, sleep, and activity without defining body size or behavior.
conditions.clinical_route: Use current appetite, sleep, weight trend, medications, and eating-pattern context to choose practical experiments.

conditions.label: Atopy and allergic-inflammation context
conditions.plain_meaning: These immune and airway markers can raise the plausibility of allergic rhinitis, eczema, asthma, or IgE-related sensitivity when the symptoms and exposures fit.
conditions.clinical_route: Match the pattern to repeatable symptoms and exposures; allergy or asthma testing can clarify a real-world trigger.

conditions.label: Inflammatory bowel disease susceptibility context
conditions.plain_meaning: These immune and barrier markers are associated with Crohn disease or ulcerative-colitis research; they matter most when persistent bowel symptoms or inflammation are present.
conditions.clinical_route: If symptoms fit, discuss CBC, CRP, fecal calprotectin, and gastroenterology evaluation.

conditions.label: Migraine and sensory-sensitivity context
conditions.plain_meaning: This pattern points to migraine and sensory-processing research, especially around trigger sensitivity; it does not predict when a migraine will occur.
conditions.clinical_route: Track headache timing, sleep, meals, hydration, cycle timing, sensory triggers, and medication response.

conditions.label: Autoimmune-thyroid susceptibility context
conditions.plain_meaning: These immune and thyroid-region markers can support a family-history or symptom-based discussion of autoimmune thyroid disease; they do not show current thyroid function.
conditions.clinical_route: Review TSH, free T4, and thyroid antibodies when symptoms or family history make it relevant.

conditions.label: Depression vulnerability research context
conditions.plain_meaning: This is an uncalibrated polygenic research module related to depression vulnerability. It is not a personal risk score and cannot explain symptoms by itself.
conditions.clinical_route: If relevant, review symptoms, duration, sleep, medications, family history, and a standard mental-health assessment.

conditions.label: Anxiety and stress-reactivity research context
conditions.plain_meaning: This is an early polygenic research module related to anxiety and stress reactivity. It is not a personal risk score or an explanation for a current symptom.
conditions.clinical_route: If relevant, compare symptoms with sleep, stressors, medications, substance use, family history, and clinical assessment.

conditions.label: Bipolar-spectrum research context
conditions.plain_meaning: These common GWAS loci have been studied in bipolar-spectrum research, but they are weak, non-specific signals and do not identify bipolar disorder.
conditions.clinical_route: Use symptoms over time, sleep and energy changes, medication history, family history, and a clinician's assessment.

conditions.label: Hereditary breast/ovarian cancer clinical route
conditions.plain_meaning: This route covers clinically important BRCA1, BRCA2, and PALB2 findings. A confirmed pathogenic or likely pathogenic clinical result can establish an inherited cancer-predisposition finding; a consumer-array observation cannot confirm it.
conditions.clinical_route: Discuss validated clinical genetic testing and genetic counseling, especially with a personal or family history of breast, ovarian, pancreatic, or prostate cancer.

conditions.label: Lynch-spectrum colorectal/endometrial cancer clinical route
conditions.plain_meaning: This route covers the main Lynch-syndrome mismatch-repair genes. A confirmed pathogenic or likely pathogenic clinical result can establish the inherited syndrome; a consumer-array observation cannot confirm it.
conditions.clinical_route: Discuss validated clinical genetic testing and genetic counseling when personal or family history suggests colorectal, endometrial, ovarian, urinary-tract, or related cancers.

conditions.label: Breast-cancer susceptibility research context
conditions.plain_meaning: These common variants are part of breast-cancer association research, but this is not a complete or calibrated risk score and does not replace routine screening or family-history assessment.
conditions.clinical_route: Review age, family history, ancestry, prior biopsies, and the screening plan with a clinician; use a validated risk model when appropriate.

conditions.label: Prostate-cancer susceptibility context
conditions.plain_meaning: These markers are associated with prostate-cancer susceptibility research. They do not diagnose cancer or determine whether screening or treatment is needed on their own.
conditions.clinical_route: Review age, family history, ancestry, urinary symptoms, and the appropriate screening discussion with a clinician.

conditions.label: Colorectal-cancer susceptibility research context
conditions.plain_meaning: These common variants are part of colorectal-cancer association research. The small set shown here is not a complete or calibrated risk score and does not replace screening.
conditions.clinical_route: Review age, family history, bowel symptoms, prior polyps, and the screening plan with a clinician.
